name: Data lane (pre-merge migration apply)
cadence: on demand (via bin/archie-fm.sh, the archie-fm */10 tick, which runs bin/data-lane-apply.sh <project> <pr> <build-dir> once per candidate PR head, BH-4927; no cron line of its own)

knobs.note: The app base the pre-merge apply POSTs to (<base>/api/internal/migrations/apply) with MIGRATION_TOKEN. Read by bin/data-lane-apply.sh as ${DATA_LANE_APP_BASE:-} from env/<project>.env. Empty is the fail-closed answer no-path (rc 5): no POST. NOT settable from the control plane — it is the host a credential is sent to, so a settings row must never re-aim it; only the sealed env file on the box moves it.

no static default — the script computes it (/root/repos/$PROJECT). Read by bin/data-lane-apply.sh as ${DATA_LANE_REPO_DIR:-/root/repos/$PROJECT}; the checkout the PR head and its diff are read from. NOT settable from the control plane — it is a path a root lane uses, so only the env file on the box moves it.
